Roxy tried to climb the icy hill, but it was very slippery. She tried again and again, but she kept falling down. Roxy was sad. She wanted to climb the icy hill so much. Then, she saw a little bird named Billy. Billy saw that Roxy was sad and asked, "Why are you sad, Roxy?"

english.text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

french.text: L'organe principal du système cardio-vasculaire est le cœur, celui-ci pompe le sang.

chinese.text: 循环系统的主要器官是心脏，心脏负责输送血液。

hindi.text: सर्कुलेटरी सिस्टम का मुख्य अंग हृदय है जो रक्त को पंप करता है.
